exceptions.reason: free-ai is the gateway: it owns the upstream provider clients and calls providers directly by design; it is not a reusable Fleet client.
The product trains and runs its own local model, and its optional evaluation harness uses native Python or Swift clients where a JavaScript package cannot apply.
The ingestion runtime is Python and now requires an explicit project-owned free-provider or local endpoint, key, and model; the JavaScript Vercel AI SDK is not applicable to this runtime.

The desktop product performs provider calls inside its Rust trust boundary and now exposes only explicit local or provider-owned routes; a JavaScript model client would cross the product security boundary.

The media pipeline is Python and calls an explicit direct free-provider endpoint; the JavaScript Vercel AI SDK is not applicable to this runtime. Moving it to the gateway needs a project id on each request.
The Apple-native product uses URLSession for local and user-selected direct endpoints inside its Swift runtime; the JavaScript Vercel AI SDK is not applicable.
The operator-side Python pipeline talks only to local MLX and LM Studio inference servers; the JavaScript Vercel AI SDK is not applicable.
This Worker calls the dedicated moderation endpoint, which is not a Vercel AI SDK text-generation surface; it remains isolated from the Fleet model-routing contract.

ratifiedBy: owner decision on https://github.com/sass-maker/saas-maker/issues/61, superseded by owner decision 2026-10-04 ('Everyone uses free AI')
ratifiedDecision: Superseding the 2026-08-29 decision (no shared AI gateway), as of 2026-10-04 every Fleet product calls the free-ai gateway at https://ai-gateway.sassmaker.com/v1 with model 'auto', authenticated by AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY, and every request carries a project id (X-Gateway-Project-Id header or project_id body field; a missing id is rejected with 400). JavaScript and TypeScript callers use the pinned Vercel AI SDK against the gateway. The gateway host and gateway environment names are the expected configuration, not findings. Direct provider calls from products and gateway calls without a project id are review-level findings; documented exceptions (free-ai itself, native and Python runtimes) are recorded below.

supersedes.decision: Fleet does not use a shared AI gateway
